grid.layout_notes: Official Game Description: 6 columns by 4 rows

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, an additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the Pacific Wave, Power Stack, Ghost Box and the bonus symbol.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: Three or more bonus symbols trigger the Pacific Wave Free Drops bonus game.

base_game_loop.summary: Pacific Gold: paid spin on 4x6. Ways to win. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x6. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, an additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

All low, mid, high and wild symbols exist in four sizes; standard 1x1, Super 2x2, Mega 3x3 and Epic 4x4. All big symbols are counted as consisting of the number of 1x1 symbol instances it covers, e.g a Super 2x2 consists of 4 standard 1x1 symbols.
